Docs.summary: Identifies the attribute that supplies an OpenCL event to an EGL synchronization object.
Docs.remarks: For EglSyncClEvent, this attribute must identify an event from clEnqueueReleaseGLObjects or clEnqueueReleaseEGLObjects. It is not a queryable synchronization-object property.

Docs.param: The EGL display on which the synchronization object was created.
The synchronization object whose signaled state is awaited.
Zero, or EglSyncFlushCommandsBit to flush the current client context before an unsignaled wait.
The timeout in nanoseconds; zero tests the current state, and EglForever disables the timeout.
Docs.summary: Waits on the calling thread for an EGL synchronization object to become signaled.
Docs.returns: EglConditionSatisfied if the object is signaled, EglTimeoutExpired if the wait times out, or EGL14.EglFalse if EGL reports an error.

remarks.para: The flush flag affects only the context currently bound to this thread. When the fence was issued in another context, that context must flush its own command stream so that the wait can complete.
Sources: the EGL specification and the Android JNI implementation.

Docs.summary: Indicates that a client wait found its synchronization object signaled.
Docs.remarks: EglClientWaitSync can return this value when the object was already signaled before the call or became signaled before the timeout.

Docs.summary: Selects the requested major version of an OpenGL or OpenGL ES context.
Docs.remarks: The attribute value is an integer version number and defaults to 1. This token is an alias of EGL_CONTEXT_CLIENT_VERSION.

Docs.summary: Selects the requested minor version of an OpenGL or OpenGL ES context.
Docs.remarks: Use this context-creation attribute with an integer minor version. Its default value is 0.

Docs.summary: Requests the OpenGL compatibility profile in a context profile mask.
Docs.remarks: This is a value bit for EglContextOpenglProfileMask, not a separate attribute name. Implementations are not required to provide the compatibility profile.

Docs.summary: Requests the OpenGL core profile in a context profile mask.
Docs.remarks: This is the default value of EglContextOpenglProfileMask. It selects a desktop OpenGL profile, not an OpenGL ES version.

Docs.summary: Selects whether context creation requests an OpenGL or OpenGL ES debug context.
Docs.remarks: Set the attribute value to EGL14.EglTrue to request a debug context, or EGL14.EglFalse otherwise. The default is false.

Docs.summary: Selects whether context creation requests a forward-compatible OpenGL context.
Docs.remarks: The attribute takes EGL14.EglTrue or EGL14.EglFalse and defaults to false. It is an attribute name, not a context-profile bit.

Docs.summary: Identifies the context-creation attribute that selects a desktop OpenGL profile.
Docs.remarks: Its value uses EglContextOpenglCoreProfileBit or EglContextOpenglCompatibilityProfileBit. The default requests the core profile.

Docs.summary: Selects the requested graphics-reset notification strategy for a context.
Docs.remarks: The value is EglLoseContextOnReset or EglNoResetNotification; the default is EglNoResetNotification. Without robust buffer access, the resulting context may not support the requested strategy.

Docs.summary: Selects whether an OpenGL or OpenGL ES context is requested with robust buffer access.
Docs.remarks: The attribute takes EGL14.EglTrue or EGL14.EglFalse and defaults to false. Context capabilities must still be checked before using required features.

Docs.param: The EGL display on which sync was created.
The synchronization object to destroy.
Docs.summary: Destroys an EGL synchronization object, deferring its deletion while existing waits still need it.
Docs.returns: true if EGL accepts the destruction request; otherwise, false.

remarks.para: When waits are pending, EGL retains the object until its associated fence or OpenCL event has completed and it no longer blocks those waits. Without pending waits, deletion is immediate.
Sources: the EGL specification and the Android JNI implementation.

Docs.summary: Specifies a client wait with no timeout.
Docs.remarks: Pass this value as the timeout to EglClientWaitSync. A wait can remain blocked indefinitely if the synchronization object is never signaled.

Docs.summary: Selects the color space used by OpenGL or OpenGL ES when rendering to an EGL surface.
Docs.remarks: For window surfaces, EglGlColorspaceLinear is the default; EglGlColorspaceSrgb requests sRGB encoding. The attribute applies to contexts that support sRGB framebuffers.

Docs.summary: Requests linear color encoding for an EGL surface's OpenGL rendering.
Docs.remarks: Use this as the value of EglGlColorspace. It corresponds to the GL_LINEAR framebuffer-attachment color encoding.

Docs.summary: Requests sRGB color encoding for an EGL surface's OpenGL rendering.
Docs.remarks: Use this as the value of EglGlColorspace. It corresponds to the GL_SRGB framebuffer-attachment color encoding.

Docs.summary: Selects an OpenGL or OpenGL ES renderbuffer as an EGL image source.
Docs.remarks: For this target, EglCreateImage requires a complete, nonzero renderbuffer that is not multisampled.

Docs.summary: Selects a two-dimensional GL texture as an EGL image source.
Docs.remarks: EglCreateImage interprets buffer as the name of a nonzero GL_TEXTURE_2D texture. EglGlTextureLevel selects the source mipmap level.

Docs.summary: Selects a slice of a three-dimensional GL texture as an EGL image source.
Docs.remarks: Use EglGlTextureLevel to select the mipmap level and EglGlTextureZoffset to select the depth slice.

Docs.summary: Selects the negative X face of a GL cube-map texture as an EGL image source.
Docs.remarks: The buffer argument identifies a nonzero cube-map texture; EglGlTextureLevel selects the mipmap level of this face.

Docs.summary: Selects the negative Y face of a GL cube-map texture as an EGL image source.
Docs.remarks: The buffer argument identifies a nonzero cube-map texture; EglGlTextureLevel selects the mipmap level of this face.

Docs.summary: Selects the negative Z face of a GL cube-map texture as an EGL image source.
Docs.remarks: The buffer argument identifies a nonzero cube-map texture; EglGlTextureLevel selects the mipmap level of this face.

Docs.summary: Selects the positive X face of a GL cube-map texture as an EGL image source.
Docs.remarks: The buffer argument identifies a nonzero cube-map texture; EglGlTextureLevel selects the mipmap level of this face.

Docs.summary: Selects the positive Y face of a GL cube-map texture as an EGL image source.
Docs.remarks: The buffer argument identifies a nonzero cube-map texture; EglGlTextureLevel selects the mipmap level of this face.

Docs.summary: Selects the positive Z face of a GL cube-map texture as an EGL image source.
Docs.remarks: The buffer argument identifies a nonzero cube-map texture; EglGlTextureLevel selects the mipmap level of this face.

Docs.summary: Selects the texture mipmap level used to create an EGL image.
Docs.remarks: The default source level is 0. This attribute applies to two-dimensional, three-dimensional, and cube-map texture targets.

Docs.summary: Selects the depth slice of a three-dimensional texture used to create an EGL image.
Docs.remarks: The default depth offset is 0. The selected offset must be less than the depth of the source mipmap level.

Docs.summary: Selects whether EGL image creation must preserve the source pixel data.
Docs.remarks: This Boolean attribute applies to all image source targets and defaults to EGL14.EglFalse.

Docs.summary: Requests a context-loss notification strategy for graphics resets.
Docs.remarks: Use this as a value of EglContextOpenglResetNotificationStrategy when creating an OpenGL or OpenGL ES context.

Docs.summary: Gets the sentinel wrapper for the absence of an EGL context.
Docs.value: An EGLContext wrapper whose native handle is zero.

remarks.para: Use this wrapper, rather than null, when an EGL15 operation requires EGL_NO_CONTEXT. The JNI handle conversion rejects a null object reference.
Sources: the EGL specification and the Android JNI implementation.

Docs.summary: Gets the sentinel wrapper for the absence of an EGL display connection.
Docs.value: An EGLDisplay wrapper whose native handle is zero.

remarks.para: The binding represents EGL_NO_DISPLAY with a zero-handle object, not a null reference.
Sources: the EGL specification and the Android JNI implementation.

Docs.summary: Gets the value used by this binding for the absence of an EGL image.
Docs.value: null, the Java EGL_NO_IMAGE field value.

remarks.para: The native EglCreateImage wrapper returns this null value when EGL reports EGL_NO_IMAGE.
Sources: the EGL specification and the Android JNI implementation.

Docs.summary: Requests a context reset strategy without reset notification.
Docs.remarks: This is the default value of EglContextOpenglResetNotificationStrategy.

Docs.summary: Gets the sentinel wrapper for the absence of an EGL rendering surface.
Docs.value: An EGLSurface wrapper whose native handle is zero.

remarks.para: The binding represents EGL_NO_SURFACE with a zero-handle object, not a null reference.
Sources: the EGL specification and the Android JNI implementation.

Docs.summary: Gets the Java field value used for the absence of an EGL synchronization object.
Docs.value: null, the Java EGL_NO_SYNC field value.

remarks.para: The Java field is null. In contrast, the pinned EglCreateSync JNI implementation constructs an EGLSync with a zero native handle when EGL reports creation failure.
Sources: the EGL specification and the Android JNI implementation.

Docs.summary: Identifies an EGL configuration that supports OpenGL ES 3.x contexts.
Docs.remarks: Use this bit in the EGL14.EglRenderableType configuration mask when selecting an OpenGL ES 3.x configuration.

Docs.summary: Selects the Android native platform for an EGL display connection.
Docs.remarks: Use this platform token with EGL14.EglDefaultDisplay as native_display in EglGetPlatformDisplay. The EGL_KHR_platform_android extension defines this request.

Docs.summary: Indicates that an EGL synchronization object's condition has been satisfied.
Docs.remarks: This is a possible result when EglGetSyncAttrib reads EglSyncStatus.

Docs.summary: Selects an EGL synchronization object linked to an OpenCL release event.
Docs.remarks: EglCreateSync requires EglClEventHandle to identify a supported OpenCL event. The synchronization condition is EglSyncClEventComplete.

Docs.summary: Identifies the condition that an EGL-linked OpenCL event has completed.
Docs.remarks: An EglSyncClEvent object becomes signaled when its associated OpenCL event reaches CL_COMPLETE.

Docs.summary: Selects the signaling condition of an EGL synchronization object for a query.
Docs.remarks: The condition is EglSyncPriorCommandsComplete for a fence or EglSyncClEventComplete for an OpenCL-event synchronization object.

Docs.summary: Selects a synchronization object backed by a client API fence command.
Docs.remarks: Creating this type inserts a fence into the current client API context's command stream. Its condition is EglSyncPriorCommandsComplete.

Docs.summary: Requests a flush of the current client API context before waiting on an unsignaled object.
Docs.remarks: Pass this bit in EglClientWaitSync flags. It is ignored if no context is current, and it does not flush a different context's fence commands.

Docs.summary: Identifies the fence condition that all preceding client API commands have completed.
Docs.remarks: The condition includes the fence command and all earlier commands in its context's command stream, including their effects on internal and framebuffer state.

Docs.summary: Selects the signaled or unsignaled status of an EGL synchronization object for a query.
Docs.remarks: EglGetSyncAttrib returns EglSignaled or EglUnsignaled for this attribute.

Docs.summary: Selects an EGL synchronization object's type for a query.
Docs.remarks: For the core EGL 1.5 types, the result is EglSyncFence or EglSyncClEvent.

Docs.summary: Indicates that a client wait ended before its synchronization object became signaled.
Docs.remarks: For a zero-timeout poll, EglClientWaitSync returns this value when the object is still unsignaled.

Docs.summary: Indicates that an EGL synchronization object's condition is not yet satisfied.
Docs.remarks: A newly created fence synchronization object starts in this state. EglGetSyncAttrib can read it through EglSyncStatus.

Docs.summary: Makes subsequent server-side commands wait for an EGL synchronization object without blocking the calling thread.
Docs.returns: true if EGL queued the server-side wait successfully; otherwise, false.

remarks.para: Only command execution for the current client API context is delayed. Other contexts are not stopped, and the calling thread can continue to submit commands. A supporting client API context must be current.
